blurb: Copperhill Brewery is a women-owned craft brewery and distillery passionate about brewing high-quality, diverse craft beer and spirits. Guests can visit their brewery in Ducktown or relax at their riverside taproom in Copperhill. They offer a variety of beers and distilled spirits including whiskey, vodka, and rum, with tasting opportunities.
